Industry News
Profound Medical to Host Analyst &
Investor Event
Profound Medical will host their inaugural Analyst & Investor
Day on April 11 in New York where Foundation Chairman
Neal Kassell, MD, will speak. This is the first event of its kind
in the focused ultrasound industry, indicating an evolution
toward commercialization. Advanced registration is required,
and there will be a live webcast available for those who
cannot attend.
